title: SCHC spec omits receiver ACK response exhaustion transition
description: schc_fragmentation.json and both Python/Rust receivers count emitted ACK responses and send Receiver-Abort instead of a fifth ACK, but draft Section 5.2 says the receiver responds to every All-1/ACK REQ and only defines MAX_ACK_REQUESTS for sender request emissions. spec/03-adaptation.md is likewise silent about receiver response exhaustion. Specify the receiver counter and fifth-request Receiver-Abort transition so the vectors and implementations are normative and interoperable; clarify terminal hold-down behavior after that abort.
notes: Final security review independently found the receiver retry vector contradicted the then-current normative state machine; spec text must explicitly make this receiver counter/abort behavior normative.
